title: A theoretical call bound is distinct from a useful implementation
statement: Under an EXACT promised Boolean quadratic chosen-evaluation oracle, four-value contrasts estimate nonnegative group influence mass/omitted risk with bounded relative variance. MOM confidence tests and best-first splitting give the stated risk-competitive acquisition construction with call dependence polynomial in k, epsilon^-1, logn, logalpha^-1 plus retained predictor recovery. Every group/coverage test and its confidence sample count is paid; source execution and dense input traffic multiply scalar calls. The supplied fixture used1,140,791 calls versus 137 for ordinary full interpolation: an explicit FAILED efficiency comparison. A noisy influence floor does not establish arbitrary-small-residual multiplicative accuracy, and finite agreement does not identify the quadratic promise. This is a Boolean-coordinate companion, not an unpriced Gaussian spectral learner. Established junta/group-query antecedents and unresolved priority are retained.
